---
id: european-robin
title: European robin
---
The European robin (*Erithacus rubecula*) is a small chat of gardens and
woodland. Individuals placed in funnel cages show a stable vanishing
bearing; that heading collapses under specific radio-frequency fields
that disrupt a light-dependent radical-pair in cryptochrome in the retina
— evidence for an inclination compass rather than a simple iron-filings
magnet. Adults show an orange face and breast.
